session_ai_commitments_paused_check.name: session_ai_commitments_paused_check
session_ai_commitments_paused_check.value: ("session_ai_commitments"."paused_at" is not null) or ("session_ai_commitments"."paused_reason" is null and "session_ai_commitments"."paused_by" is null)

session_audio_recordings_size_duration_c.name: session_audio_recordings_size_duration_check
session_audio_recordings_size_duration_c.value:
("session_audio_recordings"."duration_seconds" is null or "session_audio_recordings"."duration_seconds" >= 0)
        and ("session_audio_recordings"."size_bytes" is null or "session_audio_recordings"."size_bytes" >= 0)
        and "session_audio_recordings"."deletion_attempts" >= 0

user_feature_entitlements_window_check.name: user_feature_entitlements_window_check
user_feature_entitlements_window_check.value: "user_feature_entitlements"."expires_at" is null or "user_feature_entitlements"."starts_at" is null or "user_feature_entitlements"."expires_at" > "user_feature_entitlements"."starts_at"

user_packages_window_check.name: user_packages_window_check
user_packages_window_check.value: "user_packages"."expires_at" is null or "user_packages"."starts_at" is null or "user_packages"."expires_at" > "user_packages"."starts_at"
